newsitem.title: UK: European veg oils close mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: European veg oils close mixed in thin trade.

text.p: European vegetable oils closed mixed after a day of thin trade, with a slight bias to the downside due to early softer indications from Chicago.
Soy and rape oil finished 0.50 to one guilder down on Wednesday's close, influenced by the slightly weaker Chicago soybean oil futures as the European market closed.
Soy oil attracted the only business of the soft oils sector, with 93 and 95.50 guilders paid for Nov/Jan and Feb/Apr respectively.
The palm oil sector closed mostly unchanged to $5 firmer, apart from crude palm oil which edged back to end $2.50 down.
The only trade during the afternoon session was for Nov/Dec material at $537.50.
Coconut and palmkernel oil finished exactly where they opened, unchanged to $5 above Wednesday's close. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8074
